```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
all_games <- read.csv("matches/all_games.csv")
```

```{r}
all_games |>
  group_by(White) |>
  summarise(whiteplayer = n()) |>

arrange(desc(whiteplayer))
```

```{r}
all_games |>
  filter(White == 'Mariorichard') |>
  group_by(Black) |>
  summarise(blackplayer = n()) |>

arrange(desc(blackplayer))
```

```{r}
mariorichard <- all_games |>
  filter(White == 'Mariorichard' | Black == 'Mariorichard')

mariorichard |>
  group_by(White) |>
  summarise(whiteplayer = n()) |>

arrange(desc(whiteplayer))

mariorichard |>
  group_by(Black) |>
  summarise(blackplayer = n()) |>

arrange(desc(blackplayer))
```

```{r}
elo <- all_games |>
  mutate(
    AvgElo = (WhiteElo + BlackElo) / 2,
    EloGroup = case_when(
      AvgElo >= 1000 & AvgElo < 1500 ~ "1000-1499",
      AvgElo >= 1500 & AvgElo < 2000 ~ "1500-1999",
      AvgElo >= 2000                  ~ "2000+",
      .default = NA
    )
  )

eco_by_group <- elo |>
  filter(!is.na(EloGroup)) |>
  group_by(EloGroup, ECO) |>
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(EloGroup) |>
  mutate(Proportion = Count / sum(Count)) |>
  
arrange(EloGroup, desc(Count))
  
write_csv(eco_by_group, "eco_by_elo_group.csv")
```

```{r}
eco_results_by_group <- all_games |>
  mutate(
    AvgElo = (WhiteElo + BlackElo) / 2,
    EloGroup = case_when(
      AvgElo >= 1000 & AvgElo < 1500 ~ "1000-1499",
      AvgElo >= 1500 & AvgElo < 2000 ~ "1500-1999",
      AvgElo >= 2000                  ~ "2000+",
      .default = NA
    ),
    Outcome = case_when(
      Result == "1-0"     ~ "White_Win",
      Result == "0-1"     ~ "Black_Win",
      Result == "1/2-1/2" ~ "Draw",
      .default = NA
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(EloGroup), !is.na(Outcome)) |>
  group_by(EloGroup, ECO, Outcome) |>
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(EloGroup, ECO) |>
  mutate(
    TotalGames = sum(Count),
    Proportion = Count / TotalGames
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Outcome,
    values_from = c(Count, Proportion),
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  arrange(EloGroup, ECO)

write_csv(eco_results_by_group, "eco_results_by_elo_group.csv")
```
